self-review-en-vi.json.scope: Own EN/VI pair only. Every191source unit in both locales, including84full paragraphs perlocale, titles, cluster titles, prompts, keyTerms andillustration alt, was selfcompared against exact Japanese. Source was read in seven complete bounded per-session chunks; all ownfinal strings were reread in bounded groups, and all22selfchanged fields were freshly reread against source. Actualcanonical collectTranslatableUnits exactsourceJa/orderedIDs/localekeys/nonemptystrings/Arabicdigitsequence validation PASS. Allsource-backed quoted learningexpressions retained withnative meaning; after removing those sourcequotes no unexpected Japanese/CJK residual. No otherauthor pair/review was read. This is author selfreview, not independent/native/domain approval.

corrections.sourceJa: 密実という言葉は、粒子の間がより詰まった状態を説明する時に使います。見た目が平らなことと、求められる密度になったことは同じではありません。確認する性質を区別します。
corrections.before: The word dense is used to describe a state in which spaces between particles are more tightly packed. Looking flat is not the same as reaching the required density. Distinguish the properties being checked.
corrections.translation: The word dense is used to describe a state in which particles are packed more closely together. Looking flat is not the same as reaching the required density. Distinguish the properties being checked.
corrections.reason: Describe 密実 naturally as close particle packing, not packing of empty spaces; density-versus-flatness contrast unchanged.

corrections.sourceJa: 密実という言葉は、粒子の間がより詰まった状態を説明する時に使います。見た目が平らなことと、求められる密度になったことは同じではありません。確認する性質を区別します。
corrections.before: Từ đặc chắc dùng khi mô tả trạng thái khoảng giữa các hạt được nén chặt hơn. Trông bằng phẳng không giống với đạt khối lượng riêng yêu cầu. Phân biệt tính chất cần kiểm tra.
corrections.translation: Từ đặc chắc dùng khi mô tả trạng thái các hạt được xếp sít nhau hơn. Trông bằng phẳng không giống với đạt khối lượng riêng yêu cầu. Phân biệt tính chất cần kiểm tra.
corrections.reason: Natural equivalent of 密実; do not imply empty spaces themselves are packed. Density/flatness checks retained.

corrections.sourceJa: タイヤローラーという名称は機械の種類を示しますが、転圧という名称だけでは機械や材料、必要な回数は決まりません。仕事の名称から、一つの操作方法を全ての場所へ当てはめないようにします。
corrections.before: The name pneumatic tire roller indicates a machine type, but the name rolling compaction alone does not determine the machine, material, or necessary number of passes. Avoid applying one operating method to every location from the work name.
corrections.translation: The name tire roller indicates a machine type, but the name rolling compaction alone does not determine the machine, material, or necessary number of passes. Avoid applying one operating method to every location from the work name.
corrections.reason: Remove added pneumatic qualifier; source names a tire roller type without further machine specification.

corrections.sourceJa: 根切り底は、掘削した場所の底を表す言葉です。底の高さだけでなく、土質や状態も、その上につくる構造物と関係します。予定の高さに達したことだけで、全ての確認が終わるわけではありません。
corrections.before: Đáy đào móng là từ biểu thị đáy của nơi đã đào. Không chỉ cao độ đáy mà cả loại đất và trạng thái cũng liên quan đến kết cấu xây phía trên. Chỉ đạt cao độ dự kiến không có nghĩa mọi kiểm tra đã xong.
corrections.translation: Đáy đào móng là từ biểu thị đáy của nơi đã đào. Không chỉ cao độ đáy mà cả tính chất đất và trạng thái cũng liên quan đến kết cấu xây phía trên. Chỉ đạt cao độ dự kiến không có nghĩa mọi kiểm tra đã xong.
corrections.reason: Preserve 土質 as soil properties, alongside bottom height/condition, rather than restricting to soil type.

corrections.sourceJa: 根切り底は、掘削した場所の底を表す言葉です。底の高さだけでなく、土質や状態も、その上につくる構造物と関係します。予定の高さに達したことだけで、全ての確認が終わるわけではありません。
corrections.before: A foundation excavation bottom means the bottom of the excavated location. Its soil quality and condition, as well as its height, relate to the structure built above it. Reaching the planned height alone does not complete every check.
corrections.translation: A foundation excavation bottom means the bottom of the excavated location. Its soil properties and condition, as well as its height, relate to the structure built above it. Reaching the planned height alone does not complete every check.
corrections.reason: Use soil properties consistently for 土質; all height/condition and completed-check cautions retained.

corrections.sourceJa: 床付けの仕上がりと、根切り底の土質・状態の確認を分けてください。
corrections.before: Tách kết quả sửa đáy với kiểm tra loại đất và trạng thái của đáy đào móng.

corrections.sourceJa: 法面は、勾配のある地盤の面を表す言葉です。「のり」と呼ぶこともあります。掘削した斜面や盛土の斜面など、どの場所の面かを添えると対象が明確になります。
corrections.before: A sloping ground face is a term for a ground surface with a gradient. It is also called nori in Japanese. Adding which location's surface is meant, such as an excavated slope or fill slope, makes the subject clear.
corrections.translation: A sloping ground face is a term for a ground surface with a gradient. It is also called “のり” (nori, a sloping face) in Japanese. Adding which location's surface is meant, such as an excavated slope or fill slope, makes the subject clear.
corrections.reason: Retain source-backed quoted learning expression with native meaning, consistent with own Vietnamese field.

corrections.sourceJa: 水替えは、根切り底などにたまった水を排水することに関係します。水のある場所と、取り除く目的を表す言葉です。雨水、湧き水など、状況の違いも確認する情報になります。
corrections.before: Dewatering relates to draining water pooled at foundation excavation bottoms and similar places. The term expresses where water is present and the purpose of removing it. Differences in circumstances, such as rainwater or spring water, also provide information to check.
corrections.translation: Dewatering relates to draining water pooled at foundation excavation bottoms and similar places. The term expresses where water is present and the purpose of removing it. Differences in circumstances, such as rainwater or seepage water, also provide information to check.
corrections.reason: 湧き水 in excavation context includes water emerging/seeping from ground; avoid implying only water from a named spring.

corrections.before: Tháo nước liên quan đến thoát nước đọng ở đáy đào móng và nơi tương tự. Từ này biểu thị nơi có nước và mục đích loại bỏ nước. Khác biệt tình trạng như nước mưa, nước trồi lên và các loại khác cũng là thông tin cần kiểm tra.

criticalChecks.120: All fields reread: earthwork scope covers ground/foundations/underground structures. Fill planned terrain/elevation is not always horizontal or complete merely when soil is placed. Benching targets existing sloping ground/fill contact to reduce sliding; no angle, dimensions or sequence added. Rope layout perimeter/center differs from whole excavation/workspace/shoring range.
criticalChecks.121: All fields reread: compaction reduces particle voids and increases density, distinct from adding fill or flat appearance. Rolling compaction may contextually include small machines; tire-roller type does not fix passes/operation/qualification. Tamping purpose distinguished from rammer/plate names; narrow spaces do not make machines equivalent. Water compaction depends on material/method/specification, not all soils/backfill; no quantities, drainage or operation procedure.
criticalChecks.122: All fields reread: foundation excavation distinguished from broad excavation and plant-root cutting. Bottom elevation plus soil quality/condition checks preserved. Intended extra workspace excavation is not accidental overdig or uniform width/depth. Surface trimming differs from deep whole-pit excavation. Bottom trimming differs from indoor floor finish; disturbed-ground checks and appearance-only denial retained.
criticalChecks.123: All fields reread: soil between/around piles distinguished from pile cutting/position/condition records, pile IDs retained. Embedment reference surface/end depends on component; excavation depth, whole pile length and bearing-layer penetration not merged or universally measured from pit bottom. Natural ground not literal mountain or strength guarantee; cut/fill slope surface and no shape-only safety judgment preserved. Generic end terminology self-corrected to avoid implying a pointed form.
criticalChecks.124: All fields reread: broad soil-retention purpose distinguished from retaining-wall structure and building wall, no wall-presence stability certificate. Excavation support is whole wall/support-member system with post-installation checks. Generic sheet members versus steel members and some-not-all joints, no perfect seal guarantee. Unsupported excavation is not permission based on apparent hardness; open-cut slope/support alternatives and no space-only decision preserved.
criticalChecks.125: All fields reread: accumulated excavation-bottom water, rain/seepage conditions, discharge/environment checks and no pump/discharge-choice instructions. Sump collection location differs from pumping equipment; no universal water method. Land-won sand not all mountains or uniform grading/moisture, specifications govern backfill materials/methods, no universal reuse or river-sand comparison. Tally/count scope, units/time/object and quantity versus quality retained.
criticalChecks.126: All fields reread: subgrade approximately1m below pavement as a range, not an exact plane below ground or universal1m excavation instruction; exact source digit sequences retained. Roadbase spreads loads to subgrade, surface course asphalt scope, intervening binder-course category and no one-layer/direct-contact assumptions. On-site concrete placement versus factory products, quoted 打つ/打設する/何を打つのか and placement versus striking/pile driving retained with meanings. Staged soil raising differs from contact-surface benching; 山がくる retained with collapse gloss and no evacuation/rescue/operation procedure.

kensetsu-common-session-120: Earthworks includes foundations and underground structures; fill forms planned terrain/height without requiring a horizontal finish.

Placing soil is distinct from compaction/material/stability confirmation. Benching addresses the inclined original-ground/fill contact surface and reduces sliding, with no angles, dimensions, or excavation order supplied.
Rope marking perimeter/centre/foundation location is separate from excavation range, work space and shoring.
kensetsu-common-session-121: Compaction reduces interparticle voids and raises density; flatness does not establish density.
Tenatsu can refer to small-machine compaction; machine name, task purpose, material and required repetitions are distinct. Rammer/plate names do not establish equivalence in confined locations.
Water compaction is material/method/specification-specific, not permission to wet every soil or backfill; no quantities, drainage choices or operation instructions added.
kensetsu-common-session-122: Foundation excavation is distinguished from broad excavation, with bottom elevation plus soil type/condition retained.
Extra excavation provides intentional work space rather than being an accidental overdig; no uniform width/depth.
Skimming excess surface soil differs from a whole deep pit; bottom trimming refers to excavation bottom, not indoor flooring. Disturbed soil and appearance-only limits retained.
kensetsu-common-session-123: Soil between/around piles differs from pile position/condition checks; pile IDs and soil ranges retain separate records.
Embedment length uses component-specific reference surface/tip; excavation depth, full pile length and bearing-layer penetration differ; bottom is not a universal origin.
Natural/in-situ ground does not guarantee strength or excavation stability. Sloping ground face includes cut/fill and source-backed nori expression; shape does not establish safety.
kensetsu-common-session-124: Soil retention is the broad purpose; retaining wall is the wall-shaped structure; building partition walls are distinct and wall existence does not guarantee stability.
Excavation support includes wall and supporting components, plus post-installation condition/management checks.

Sheet piles versus steel sheet piles retain material distinction and conditional joints; joints do not guarantee complete soil/water sealing. Unsupported excavation is not general authorization; open-cut can use slopes or support.
kensetsu-common-session-125: Dewatering pooled excavation-bottom water retains rain/seepage context, receiving/outflow area and surrounding impacts; no pump/discharge choice added.
Sump collection location differs from water-lifting pump equipment; method/capacity/position are not established by name alone.
Land-won sand origin does not determine grading/moisture; selected backfill material/method follows specification and not all excavated soil can return.
Manbo means counting people/vehicles/components with units, time and objects; vehicle/pile counts and quantity/quality are separate.
kensetsu-common-session-126: Subgrade is an approximate 1-metre range below pavement, not a plane exactly 1 metre below ground surface and not instruction to dig 1 metre everywhere. Source Arabic digit sequences preserved exactly in both locales.
Road base spreads load to subgrade; asphalt surface course differs, possible binder layer retained, no one-layer/direct-contact assumption.
Cast-in-place versus factory concrete installation retained; source-backed utsu/dasetsu expressions and native gloss distinguish placement from hitting and pile driving without adding procedures.

Staged raising/removal of soil differs from contact-surface benching; yama ga kuru expresses excavation-slope collapse with native gloss, not transport or a literal approaching mountain; no evacuation/rescue procedure added.
